server.title: Lyon
server.description: The city I lived in since 10 years now

live.instructions:
This MCP server provides an authoritative, up-to-date knowledge base about Lyon, covering restaurants, attractions, walks, and practical information like weather and parking. Use it to offer personalized, local recommendations.

## Tools
- `search_lyon_content`: Use for in-depth information on restaurants, brunch, local eateries, and walking routes. Returns detailed passages and sources.
- `search_lyon_places`: Use to find specific places, points of interest, or neighborhoods when coordinates or general location information is needed. Essential before using map tools.
- `get_lyon_weather`: Use to get current weather conditions and forecasts for activity planning.
- `show_lyon_weather`: Use to display a user-friendly weather widget.
- `search_parkings`: Use to find available parking lots near a specified location.
- `get_parking_lot`: Use to get detailed information about a specific parking lot by name.
- `show_parking_spot`: Use to display a parking lot's live availability and pricing.
- `display_lyon_map`: Use to show recommended locations or routes on a map. Requires coordinates from `search_lyon_places`.
- `show_metro_line`: Use to display a diagram of a metro line, including station information and train arrivals.
- `get_metro_line`: Use to get a list of stations and real-time departures for a specific metro or funicular line.
- `send_lyon_email`: Use to send feedback or requests to the Lyon space team.

## Example
User: "Where can I find a good bouchon for dinner tonight, and what's the weather like?"
Agent: Call `search_lyon_content` for "bouchon" to find recommendations. Then, call `get_lyon_weather` to check the forecast. Combine the information to provide a restaurant suggestion and inform about the weather.

tools.name: get_metro_line
tools.title: Get Lyon Metro Line
tools.description: Use this when the user asks which stations a metro or funicular line serves, or wants next departures at each stop. Returns the full ordered list of stations for the given line, with the next departure time in each direction at every station.

lineId.description: Metro or funicular line code, e.g. 'A', 'B', 'D', 'F1', 'F2'.

tools.name: show_parking_spot
tools.title: Show Parking Spot Details
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to see a parking lot's availability, price and details shown as a card. Renders a parking-lot card with available and total spaces, price, EV charging spots, height limit, opening hours, services and distance. Get a parking lot's availability, price and details from get_parking_lot first. Get a parking lot's availability, price and details from search_parkings first.

total.description: Total number of EV charging spots at the parking lot, e.g. from get_parking_lot or search_parkings.

available.description: Number of EV charging spots currently free, from get_parking_lot or search_parkings.

ev.description: EV charging spot counts for the parking lot, combining the total and available figures below.

name.description: Name of the parking lot to display, from get_parking_lot or search_parkings.

total.description: Total capacity of the parking lot.

address.description: Full street address of the parking lot.

distance.description: Distance from the user to the parking lot, e.g. '240m'.

services.description: Services offered at the parking lot, e.g. covered parking or surveillance.

available.description: Number of parking spaces currently available.

openHours.description: Opening hours of the parking lot, e.g. '24/7'.

priceUnit.description: Unit the price applies to, e.g. per hour or per day.

tools.name: show_journey
tools.title: Show Journey Details
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to see a planned journey's route, mode and arrival countdown displayed as a card. Renders a journey card showing origin, destination, transport mode and a countdown to arrival based on the given duration.

to.description: Destination of the journey to display.

from.description: Starting point of the journey to display.

mode.description: Mode of transport used for the journey.

durationSeconds.description: Total journey duration in seconds, used to render the countdown to arrival.

tools.name: search_lyon_content
tools.title: Search Lyon Guide
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about Lyon or the subjects it covers. Covers: restaurant recommendations, brunch spots, pizzerias in Lyon, where locals eat, morning walks, weekend outings, neighborhood food guides, Lyon dining tips. Returns verbatim passages from the space's own content, kept current by its owners, each under the title of the entry it comes from. An empty result can mean the query was too narrow; a rephrased query may find the answer. Time-limited content (e.g. a daily special or a weekly schedule) is filtered out once expired, so when nothing current answers a question about today or this week, it has not been published yet. A passage carrying a "validUntil" date is a time-limited exception (e.g. an exceptional closure or opening) that overrides a permanent passage on the same topic until that date; the passage says when the period ends, or when it starts if it hasn't started yet.

tools.name: display_lyon_map
tools.title: Display Lyon Map
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to see Lyon places plotted on an interactive map. Renders a map with the given places plotted by their titles and coordinates. Get the places and their coordinates from search_lyon_places first.

title.description: Heading shown above the map, e.g. "Bouchons near Bellecour". Omitted: no heading
Name of the place, shown on its marker card

description.description: One or two sentences shown under the title: what the item is and why it matters to the user

imageUrl.description: Image URL (https). Supplied by you — no lookup is performed.

badge.description: Short highlight displayed with the item, such as a price ("12 €"), a status ("Open now") or a category

label.description: Text of the button, phrased as what the user will get ("See the menu")

prompt.description: Follow-up message sent to the assistant when clicked

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84), as returned by a search or geocoding tool

lng.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84), as returned by a search or geocoding tool

rating.description: Rating shown next to a star on the place card, on the scale of its source (e.g. 4.5 out of 5). Omit it when unknown: 0 or absent hides it

tags.description: Short keywords listed on the place card, such as cuisine, type of venue or amenities

items.description: Places to display, one numbered marker each, in the order given

totalResults.description: Number of places actually placed on the map

location.description: Address as supplied, empty when none was given

places.description: The places shown, in marker order (marker 1 first)

tools.name: get_lyon_weather
tools.title: Get Current Weather
tools.description: Use this when the user asks for the current weather in Lyon or any other city. Returns the current temperature in °C, conditions in words such as 'light rain', and wind speed and direction. Not for rendering a weather card; use show_lyon_weather.

location.description: City name, optionally with country code (e.g. 'Lyon, FR', 'Paris')

country.description: ISO 3166 country code of the resolved city, empty when unknown

description.description: Current conditions in words, e.g. "light rain"

tools.name: show_metro_line
tools.title: Show Metro Line Diagram
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to see a metro line's stations, current position and next arrivals displayed as a diagram. Renders a metro line diagram with the ordered stations, the current station, transfer points and the next arrivals in minutes. Get the stations and next departures from get_metro_line first.

line.description: Line number or letter, e.g. 'A' or 'D', matching a line from get_metro_line.

lineName.description: Full line name to display, e.g. 'Métro A'.

passed.description: Whether this station has already been passed.

current.description: Whether this is the station the user is currently at.

transfer.description: Names or numbers of lines that can be transferred to at this station.

stations.description: Ordered list of stations on the line, from get_metro_line.

direction.description: Direction or terminus of travel, e.g. 'Olympiades'.

lineColor.description: Hex color code of the line, used to style the diagram.

nextArrivals.description: Minutes until the next trains arrive, e.g. [3, 7, 12], from get_metro_line.

currentStation.description: Name of the station where the user currently is.

tools.name: get_parking_lot
tools.title: Find Lyon Parking Lot
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about a specific named parking lot's availability or price in Lyon. Returns the full real-time record for the matched parking lot, including availability and pricing. Not for searching for parking lots near a destination; use search_parkings.

name.description: Parking name, exact or approximate, e.g. 'Terreaux', 'LPA Terreaux', 'terreaux'.

tools.name: search_parkings
tools.title: Search Lyon Parking Lots
tools.description: Use this when the user wants parking options near an address, point of interest or neighbourhood in Lyon. Returns open parking lots within a radius of the given destination, sorted by distance, with real-time availability. Not for looking up one specific named parking lot; use get_parking_lot.

radius_m.description: Search radius in metres around the destination (default: 800).

destination.description: Free-text destination to search near, e.g. 'Opéra de Lyon', 'Bellecour', '69001'.

min_available.description: Only return parking lots with at least this many available spaces.

tools.name: send_lyon_email
tools.title: Send Message to Lyon Team
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to contact the person behind this Lyon space, for example to make a request or ask a question. Sends an email with the collected date and time, phone number and reason for the request to the space's fixed recipient. The email is sent for real to the fixed recipient and cannot be recalled; confirm the date, time, phone number and reason with the user before sending.

from_name.description: Full name of the person making the request, shown as the sender

from_email.description: The user's email address. The team's reply goes to it, so ask the user for it rather than guessing

subject.description: Subject line the team reads first: what the request is about, in a few words

body.description: Email body collecting the desired date and time, a phone number, and the reason for the request; compose it as a clear message before sending.

sent.description: True once the email has been handed to the mail provider

team.description: Name the team signs with, to tell the user who received the request

replyTo.description: The address the team's reply will go to, as supplied in from_email

tools.name: search_lyon_places
tools.title: Search Lyon Places
tools.description: Use this when the user asks where something is in Lyon, what is nearby, or which places Lyon covers. Covers: restaurant locations, places to eat, walking routes, neighborhoods in Lyon, points of interest, addresses in Lyon, maps of Lyon spots. Returns matching places with their coordinates, from content kept current by the space's owners. Map and display tools render only the values they are given, so this is where their coordinates come from. An empty result can mean the query was too narrow; a rephrased query may find the place.

query.description: What to look for, in natural language: a place name, a type of venue or an area (e.g. "bouchon lyonnais in Vieux Lyon")

tools.name: show_lyon_weather
tools.title: Show Weather Card
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a weather forecast for a city shown as a visual card. Renders a weather card with temperature, condition, sunrise and sunset for one city and day. Get the current temperature and conditions from get_lyon_weather first.

day.description: Day the weather card applies to, e.g. 'today' or a specific date.

city.description: City the weather card displays, e.g. Lyon.

unit.description: Temperature scale used to display the temperature.

temperature.description: Temperature value to display, in the scale given by `unit`.

tools.name: search_lyon_news
tools.title: Search News Articles
tools.description: Use this when the user asks for recent news articles about Lyon or any other topic, country or time period. Returns matching news articles, ten per page, optionally filtered by country, language and recency period.

gl.description: Country code for news region (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Determines which country's news sources to prioritize.

hl.description: Language code for news interface and results. Most languages use ISO 639-1 codes (e.g., 'en', 'es'). Chinese requires regional variants: 'zh-cn' (Simplified) or 'zh-tw' (Traditional). Standalone 'zh' is normalized to 'zh-cn'.

when.description: Time filter for news articles. 'd' = past day, 'w' = past week, 'm' = past month, 'y' = past year. These are coarse UTC-based buckets with no finer granularity; filter `published_at` client-side for precise ranges. Combining narrow queries with strict `when` filters frequently returns zero results; broaden either before concluding no data exists.

query.description: Search query for news articles. Supports advanced operators like 'site:', 'when:', etc. Cannot be used with topic_token, publication_token, or story_token.

start.description: Result offset for pagination. Each page typically contains 10 results. Use multiples of 10 (0, 10, 20, 30, ...) to navigate pages. Stop paginating when a page returns no new results.
